# E0332: property that isn't a closure with typed parameters

A property is a closure with typed parameters that returns a `bool`, as `/// prop: |xs: List<i64>| …`, since `stilt test` generates values of each type. A check without parameters is an example, `/// ex:`.

- Rule: [`tests.property-form`](../../reference/19-tools.md#tests.property-form)
- Reported at: the property's expression, or the parameter without a type or marked `inout`.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0332:1
/// prop: |xs| reverse(reverse(xs)) == xs
fn reverse(xs: List<i64>) -> List<i64> { xs.fold([], |acc, x| [x].concat(acc)) }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
/// prop: |xs: List<i64>| reverse(reverse(xs)) == xs
fn reverse(xs: List<i64>) -> List<i64> { xs.fold([], |acc, x| [x].concat(acc)) }
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0332_inout_property_parameter.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0332_inout_property_parameter.lt):

```text
── PROPERTY THAT ISN'T A CLOSURE WITH TYPED PARAMETERS ── E0332_inout_property_parameter.lt:1:18  [E0332]

This parameter is `inout`, but a property's parameters take generated values:

  1 │ /// prop: |inout xs: List<i64>| reverse(reverse(xs)) == xs
    │                  ^^

A property is a closure with typed parameters that returns a `bool`, as `///
prop: |xs: List<i64>| …`, since `stilt test` generates values of each type. A
check without parameters is an example, `/// ex:`.

To fix it, delete the `inout`:

  1 │ /// prop: |inout xs: List<i64>| reverse(reverse(xs)) == xs
    │            ------
```

`stilt check` on [`E0332_property_that_isn_t_a_closure_with_typed_parameters.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0332_property_that_isn_t_a_closure_with_typed_parameters.lt):

```text
── PROPERTY THAT ISN'T A CLOSURE WITH TYPED PARAMETERS ── E0332_property_that_isn_t_a_closure_with_typed_parameters.lt:1:12  [E0332]

The parameter `xs` has no type, so no values can be generated for it:

  1 │ /// prop: |xs| reverse(reverse(xs)) == xs
    │            ^^

A property is a closure with typed parameters that returns a `bool`, as `///
prop: |xs: List<i64>| …`, since `stilt test` generates values of each type. A
check without parameters is an example, `/// ex:`.

To fix it, write the type of `xs`:

  1 │ /// prop: |xs: List<i64>| reverse(reverse(xs)) == xs
    │              +++++++++++
```
